PURE_EVIL.Title: Pure Evil
PURE_EVIL.Roster.Empty: No player has a character assigned yet. Assign one in the Players list and it will show up here.
PURE_EVIL.Roster.Toggle: Take control of this character's dice
PURE_EVIL.Dice.AddHint: How many faces? Dice the table actually rolls are added here automatically - this is only for setting one up in advance.
PURE_EVIL.Weights.TooMany: This die has more than {max} faces - too many to weight one by one. Forced rolls still work on it.
PURE_EVIL.Forced.Empty: Nothing forced. The dice are honest.
PURE_EVIL.Panel.NoCharacter: Pick a character on the left.
PURE_EVIL.Panel.Disabled: Control is off - flip the switch on this character's row
PURE_EVIL.Footer.MasterHint: Master switch - off means every die in the world rolls fair, whatever is configured here.
PURE_EVIL.Notify.ForceQueued: Next {die} for this character will roll {value} ({times}x).
PURE_EVIL.Footer.Subject: Your rolls: {name}
PURE_EVIL.Footer.SubjectHint: Whose tables apply to rolls made on THIS client, in order. A GM always gets their own queue first; a selected token or an assigned character is checked after it.
PURE_EVIL.Dice.Title: Die
PURE_EVIL.HubGate.Title: Dungeons LAB Hub required
PURE_EVIL.HubGate.Body: This module only works with Dungeons LAB Hub - turning the Hub off breaks its settings. While the Hub is disabled, Pure Evil stays off and no dice are touched.
PURE_EVIL.HubGate.Note: Enable Dungeons LAB Hub and reload the world to get everything back. Your saved probabilities and forced rolls are untouched.
PURE_EVIL.Relationship.DiceSoNice: 3D dice - Pure Evil rigs the roll, Dice So Nice shows it landing.
PURE_EVIL.Relationship.DiceTray: Quick dice buttons in chat - handy for firing off the rolls you have rigged.
